why: Take 3 has the only real turn. Inez says yes too fast, and the Fixer makes her hear the price. Her fear then has somewhere to go.
changes: Replaced the card arriving by tube with Take 1's saucer. A tube delivery at a café table is a stretch, while a card under a saucer is quiet and suits her fear of being seen.
Removed "He's never missed a shift" because the sheet doesn't give it, and replaced "Only us" with "It stays with us", a promise the Fixer can keep without claiming who else knows.
Rewrote her realisation as "Why would he... you know about us" so the secret is clear without being explicit. "Who else knows?" stays as the frightened question.
Replaced the Fixer's "You're with us?" and her "I call him off" with her own "I'm with you". The first yes is panic and this one is meant; the call itself is already plain in beat 3.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Look under my saucer, Inez. The rest of your loan's paid.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: My Bureau card. Yes, whatever it is, only put it away.

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Hear it first. When I telephone, call Okafor over from his door.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Why would he... you know about us. Who else knows?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: It stays with us. He'd stand with you about a minute.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: A minute off that door. What happens to him?

beats.speaker: Fixer
beats.line: Nothing, if this goes right. He never sees us.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I'm with you. I see trouble on that square, I'll warn you.

learned: Loan paid. Inez is with us.
